Privacy · updated 3 November 2026

What this site measures.

creativemcp.com uses Google Analytics to learn which pages and setup paths help people. It has no accounts, forms or ads, and nothing you do with the local tools reaches this site.

What is measured

The site uses Google Analytics 4 (property G-JBJ1NMP96V). It records:

  • pages viewed, the page you came from, and standard browser details Google Analytics collects, such as device type, browser and approximate location;
  • clicks on named links and buttons: which one, and where it leads;
  • switching between light and dark themes;
  • in the setup builder on Get started: the implementation, client and install method you choose, copying the command, and finishing the readiness checklist;
  • words typed into the documentation and feature searches, the number of results, and which result you open; feature filters you apply.

Google Analytics 4 does not log or store IP addresses. Reports keep data for 14 months. Visits from the site owner and from development previews are filtered out.

What is stored in your browser

  • Google Analytics sets first-party cookies named _ga and _ga_JBJ1NMP96V to tell visits apart.
  • If you choose a theme, it is saved on your device as adobe-mcp-theme in local storage. It is never sent anywhere.

What the site does not do

  • The setup builder and checklist run in your browser. They cannot see your computer, installed apps or files.
  • The MCP servers and the creative-mcp installer run on your own machine and send nothing to this site. The installer has no telemetry.
  • Nothing is sold, and there is no advertising.

Your choices

You can block Google Analytics with your browser’s tracking protection, a content blocker, or Google’s opt-out add-on. Every page still works with analytics blocked, and with JavaScript off the content stays readable; the interactive tools point to their written equivalents.

Questions or requests: open an issue or contact Zach Shallbetter.
